label.description: Deleting the unittest.SkipTest-to-pytest.skip conversion from pytest_runtest_makereport makes `raise unittest.SkipTest` (in setUpClass or in a plain test function) report as an error/failure instead of a skip; the conversion was not nose-only.

reason: The range includes the location of the removed SkipTest conversion, whose deletion causes these skips to be reported as failures or errors.

label.description: pytest_generate_tests no longer skips argnames that the test itself parametrizes, so a parametrized fixture overridden by an indirect @pytest.mark.parametrize gets parametrized twice ('duplicate parametrization').

reason: The range covers the fixture-definition lookup adjacent to the removed guard that previously prevented duplicate parametrization.

label.description: When no args are given, the invocation-dir fallback no longer scans its test* subdirectories, so conftest.py files in <invocation dir>/test* are not loaded as initial conftests (their pytest_addoption never runs).

reason: The fallback sets only the invocation directory as an anchor, omitting the test* subdirectory scan previously performed by _try_load_conftest.

label.description: The rootdir's own conftest is now scoped to the rootdir Directory node instead of session-wide, so its fixtures (and doctest_namespace injections) are invisible to items collected from outside the rootdir.

reason: Parsing the rootdir conftest against its Directory collector restricts its fixtures to that subtree rather than preserving session-wide visibility.

label.description: The new Decimal-tolerance check reads `.flat` on any sequence-like expected value, which crashes pytest.approx for array types (e.g. JAX arrays) whose `.flat` raises, whenever an inexact float rel/abs is passed.

reason: The new getattr at line 1036 raises NotImplementedError for sequence-like arrays whose flat property is unimplemented, and the inexact-tolerance check calls it.

label.description: SecretStr.__eq__ passes str values straight to secrets.compare_digest, which raises TypeError for non-ASCII strings, so comparing SecretStr('café') with itself crashes.

reason: Line 1891 passes string values directly to compare_digest, which raises TypeError for non-ASCII strings.

label.description: Bare collections.abc.MutableSequence is dispatched to the generic Sequence schema instead of the list schema, so it accepts any Sequence (even a str) unchanged instead of validating and coercing to a list.

reason: Line 375 dispatches bare MutableSequence to the sequence schema instead of the list schema, causing the regression.

label.description: _generate_schema_inner now trusts an origin computed by the caller before `Self` is resolved, so when `Self` resolves to a parametrized generic (e.g. SelfRef[int]) the stale origin (None) is used and schema generation for it breaks.

reason: The cached origin is reused after Self resolves to a potentially parametrized generic, so it must be recomputed at this location.
